note: Each eval runs in a folder holding one ~60s vertical talking-head clip that also shows a screen recording, with its transcript pre-cached so runs cost no transcription credits. No human answers questions during a run, which also tests how the skill behaves when the user is unavailable. Supply your own clip to reproduce.

evals.name: defaults-full-edit
evals.prompt: Shu papkadagi videoni professional montaj qilib ber. Men montajni bilmayman, shuning uchun hamma narsani o'zing hal qil — qanday yaxshi bo'lsa shunday qil. Instagram Reels uchun kerak.
evals.expected_output: Finished vertical MP4 in footage/edit/, dead air and stumbles cut, burned Uzbek subtitles, measured loudness reported, defaults listed compactly instead of blocking on questions.
assertions: Produced a playable MP4 in outputs/
Output is vertical 9:16 (1080x1920)
Output is shorter than the 63.07s source, so dead air or stumbles were actually cut
Uzbek subtitles are burned into the picture
notes.md reports a measured loudness value in LUFS, not an estimate
questions.md is written in Uzbek, matching the language the user wrote in
Did not re-transcribe: edit/transcripts still holds exactly the one cached file
No cut lands inside a spoken word (no stuttered syllable at any cut)

evals.name: stated-prefs
evals.prompt: Edit the video in this folder into a 9:16 reel under 45 seconds. I want burned-in Uzbek subtitles, quiet background music, and a title card on the opening claim. Don't ask me about those four things, I've decided them. Tell me the loudness numbers when you're done.
evals.expected_output: Honors all four stated preferences without re-asking, output under ~45s, music mixed under speech, loudness numbers reported from a measurement of the final file.
assertions: Produced a playable MP4 in outputs/
Output duration is under 45 seconds
Output is vertical 9:16
Uzbek subtitles are burned in
Background music is present and sits below the voice
A title card appears over the opening claim
Loudness numbers are reported and come from measuring the final file
questions.md does not re-ask about aspect ratio, subtitles, music or the title card

evals.name: subtitles-only
evals.prompt: just add uzbek subtitles to this video, nothing else. don't cut anything, don't add music.
evals.expected_output: Video with burned-in subtitles only. No cuts, no music, no graphics. Scope respected.
assertions: Produced a playable MP4 in outputs/
Duration matches the 63.07s source within 0.5s, proving nothing was cut
Uzbek subtitles are burned in
No background music was added
No motion graphics, labels or highlight boxes were added
Scope was respected: the reply does not upsell extra editing as if it had been done
